name: Zul'Gurub: High Priestess Mar'li does not Evolve herself (#8075)
contract: Evolve (2118116) evolves a target spider egg: it heals its target to full health (effect 67) and applies a
+200% scale aura. Mar'li (14510) casts it 22 s into the troll phase on a Spawn of Mar'li (15041) she hatches
from the nearest standing egg (179985), never on herself, so she neither carries the Evolve aura nor heals to
full health. The world's eggs share phase 1 and the fixture lives in the lane's own phase, so the hero places
one egg after Hatch Eggs has used the others, for Evolve to hatch. It has no duration,
because the core does not count a timed player summon as spawned and Mar'li would pass it over. She picks
the egg as the cast starts, which can precede the placement, so the case allows one more 60 s Evolve cycle.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: Mar'li has her one-player flex health
Wound Mar'li to about 60%, above her spider phase
CONTROL: Mar'li is wounded and has not Evolved yet
CONTROL: the troll phase reaches Hatch Eggs at 17 s
Place a Spider Egg for Evolve to hatch
CONTROL: Mar'li is alive and still fighting
CONTROL: Mar'li casts Evolve, at the latest one 60 s cycle after the egg appears
The Spawn of Mar'li hatched from the egg carries Evolve
Mar'li was not healed to full health
